paragraphs.text: Many people put items in the recycling bin that cannot be recycled, which can spoil a whole lorry load. Greasy pizza boxes are a common example, because the oil stops the cardboard from being made into new paper.
Plastic bags should not go in household recycling bins, as they get caught in the sorting machines and stop them working. Most large supermarkets collect them separately.
Glass bottles and jars are accepted, but drinking glasses and window glass are not, because they melt at a different temperature.
Food cans should be rinsed before recycling. They do not need to be perfectly clean, but leftover food can attract insects and make the bins smell.
Batteries must never be put in household bins. They can cause fires in collection lorries and should be taken to the collection points found in many shops.
If you are not sure whether something can be recycled, check the list on the council website before putting it in the bin.

items.quote: Most large supermarkets collect them separately

explanation.en: “Most large supermarkets collect them separately” → D. F sounds logical, but the text says to take bags to supermarkets.

explanation.ru: Стаканы не принимают, «because they melt at a different temperature» → C.

items.quote: They do not need to be perfectly clean
keywords: do not need to be perfectly clean

explanation.en: Cans should be rinsed, but “They do not need to be perfectly clean” → E “only need a quick rinse”.
explanation.kk: Банкаларды шаю керек, бірақ «They do not need to be perfectly clean» → E «only need a quick rinse».
explanation.ru: Банки нужно ополоснуть, но «They do not need to be perfectly clean» → E «only need a quick rinse».

items.quote: They can cause fires in collection lorries

explanation.en: Batteries in household bins are dangerous: “They can cause fires in collection lorries”, so they go to shop collection points → A.
explanation.kk: Қарапайым қоқыстағы батарея қауіпті: «They can cause fires in collection lorries», сондықтан оны дүкендегі пунктке тапсырады → A.
explanation.ru: Батарейки в обычном мусоре опасны: «They can cause fires in collection lorries», поэтому их сдают в пункты в магазинах → A.
